emails.subject: May walkthrough — house side list
emails.body: Did my walkthrough Saturday morning. Two problems on my side of the place: the boathouse door latch has rusted through and will not turn, and an ice dam pulled down a six-foot gutter section over the porch. Both should go on the board before opening weekend. Let me know when the gutter people are booked. — Tove

emails.subject: Winter damage — waterfront list
emails.body: Walked the waterfront yesterday. Two things for the list from me: two rungs snapped off the dock ladder, and the flag halyard is frayed to threads and needs replacing. I can take small jobs myself once they are on the list. — Marcel
